text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During practice, Narita Brian suffered a 
minor injury.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Something like this isn't even a scratch, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm telling you I'm fine—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list:
Come on, let's treat those injuries 
properly.

Come on, let's treat those injuries 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian was left feeling down from 
being unable to train...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah, let's start again right away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A scratch like this will heal if you just 
spit on—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it, and when time is so precious 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is no place... to be resting...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I soothed Narita Brian, who was trying to 
push through her injury and train anyway, 
and decided to have her rest...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Keep going? I never intended to stop 
practicing in the first place, you know?
choice_data_list: Then at least let me treat your wounds.
Then at least let me patch you up, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As soon as you're done treating this, I'm 
going running. We clear?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proper treatment seemed to do the 
trick. We were able to continue training 
afterward!
